Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray and CT images demonstrate an ill-defined area of consolidation in the left lower lobe (specifically the superior segment) without associated hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy. This radiographic pattern, particularly when combined with a clinical history of failing to respond to antibiotics, is characteristic of Bronchiolitis Obliterans Organizing Pneumonia (BOOP), also known as Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
